description: Studio templates (D-069), opened from "Start from template" in the Layers tab. A template sets the layer stack and presets and, when it names targets, a site screening whose site the person then picks (D-076). Layer IDs live here, not in site/. Nothing here is designed or named for official notices (D-041).

site_screening.title: Site screening
site_screening.summary: Wetlands, flood zones and Category 1 waters within 300 ft of a parcel, an address or a drawn site.

equity_screening.title: Equity screening
equity_screening.summary: Overburdened Communities over tract poverty rates, with contaminated sites, flood zones and wetlands.
